title: Crane Longform
description: Forty-five balance and active-flexibility intervals from the canonical Fable W4 routine.

intervals.coachNote: Ramp the march with relaxed arm circles; no bounce.
Move through a comfortable cat-cow range without forcing the overhead position.
Swing the leg from small to bigger arcs with a stable trunk; no ballistic kick.
regressions: Use a wall and keep the pendulum small if balance or the hip range is limited.

intervals.coachNote: Swing the leg from small to bigger arcs with a stable trunk; no ballistic kick.
regressions: Use a wall and keep the pendulum small if balance or the hip range is limited.

intervals.coachNote: Rock side to side through a controlled squat range with the feet planted.
regressions: Use a smaller range or support rather than forcing the great toe.

intervals.coachNote: Slide the arms only through a comfortable range; keep the ribs controlled.
regressions: Use a smaller range or stop before shoulder apprehension.

intervals.coachNote: Prepare the ankles with pumps and heel-to-toe rocks; calf raises come later.
Step to the left and balance on a flat foot; do not hop.
regressions: Use a wall or shorten the step; keep the landing quiet.

intervals.coachNote: Step to the right and balance on a flat foot; do not hop.
regressions: Use a wall or shorten the step; keep the landing quiet.

intervals.coachNote: Hold the left crane stance; split the interval into two holds if form fades.
regressions: Use a toe tap or wall support and shorten the hold before balance quality drops.

intervals.coachNote: Hold the right crane stance; split the interval into two holds if form fades.
regressions: Use a toe tap or wall support and shorten the hold before balance quality drops.

intervals.coachNote: Use a low step, descend for three seconds, and keep the pelvis level.
regressions: Lower the step or use support; keep the whole foot planted.

intervals.coachNote: Use a low step, descend for three seconds, and keep the pelvis level.
regressions: Lower the step or use support; keep the whole foot planted.

intervals.coachNote: Kick slowly with the wall available; do not force the pivot or snap.
regressions: Use wall support and lower the kick height.

intervals.coachNote: Kick slowly with the wall available; do not force the pivot or snap.
regressions: Use wall support and lower the kick height.

intervals.coachNote: Chamber slowly with wall support available; avoid a forceful pivot.
regressions: Use wall support and reduce the knee height or range.

intervals.coachNote: Chamber slowly with wall support available; avoid a forceful pivot.
regressions: Use wall support and reduce the knee height or range.

intervals.coachNote: Hold one dumbbell at the chest and use a 1.5-rep or paused squat with heels down.
regressions: Use a lighter load or smaller range while keeping the heels down.

intervals.coachNote: Use a push-up plus with controlled scapular reach and no shoulder apprehension.
regressions: Use knees-down or hands-elevated; fists do not unload the first MTP.

intervals.coachNote: Use a moderate range with the whole foot planted and the knee tracking over the foot.
regressions: Shorten the range or use support rather than forcing the great toe.

intervals.coachNote: Use a moderate range with the whole foot planted and the knee tracking over the foot.
regressions: Shorten the range or use support rather than forcing the great toe.

intervals.coachNote: Start with 4–5 kg, keep the feet planted with no heel pop, and stop on shoulder apprehension.
regressions: Use a lighter dumbbell or a high-pull range that stays comfortable.

intervals.coachNote: Start with 4–5 kg, keep the feet planted with no heel pop, and stop on shoulder apprehension.
regressions: Use a lighter dumbbell or a high-pull range that stays comfortable.

intervals.coachNote: Use a stable hinge, pull both dumbbells with a quiet neck, and squeeze at the top.
regressions: Use a lighter load or a more upright hinge if the back position changes.

intervals.coachNote: Carry one dumbbell tall, switch hands at 20 seconds, and march without bouncing.
regressions: Use a lighter dumbbell or lower the knee lift while keeping the trunk tall.

intervals.coachNote: Hinge with two dumbbells, pause at a strong depth, and keep the back long.
regressions: Use lighter dumbbells or shorten the range while keeping the whole foot loaded.

intervals.coachNote: Keep the pelvis level and use the long-lever option only if control stays clean.
regressions: Use a bilateral bridge or shorten the lever if pelvic control fades.

intervals.coachNote: Keep the pelvis level and use the long-lever option only if control stays clean.
regressions: Use a bilateral bridge or shorten the lever if pelvic control fades.

intervals.coachNote: Move slowly and exhale; keep the back quiet against the floor.
regressions: Keep the feet supported or reduce the limb range if the back arches.

intervals.tempo: 3 s up / 1 s pause / 3 s down
intervals.coachNote: Use the prescribed cadence and keep the forefoot stable; never bounce.
regressions: Use support or less load; keep pain 0–3/10, below the 5/10 ceiling, and settled by next morning.

intervals.tempo: 3 s up / 1 s pause / 3 s down
intervals.coachNote: Use the prescribed cadence and keep the forefoot stable; never bounce.
regressions: Use support or less load; keep pain 0–3/10, below the 5/10 ceiling, and settled by next morning.

intervals.tempo: 3 s up / 1 s pause / 3 s down
intervals.coachNote: Place a dumbbell on the thigh and load the soleus deliberately.
regressions: Use less load or bilateral work within the same pain rules.

intervals.tempo: 3 s up / 1 s pause / 3 s down
intervals.coachNote: Place a dumbbell on the thigh and load the soleus deliberately.
regressions: Use less load or bilateral work within the same pain rules.

intervals.coachNote: Control the pelvis through a small hip hitch without hiking the shoulder.
regressions: Use wall support and reduce the range if the lateral hip becomes painful.

intervals.coachNote: Control the pelvis through a small hip hitch without hiking the shoulder.
regressions: Use wall support and reduce the range if the lateral hip becomes painful.

intervals.coachNote: Use unweighted Y/W shapes with a two-second hold and relaxed neck.
regressions: Use only the range that keeps the shoulder comfortable.

intervals.coachNote: Work about 20 seconds per foot: spread the toes and gently lift the arch without gripping.
regressions: Use a seated version or reduce the hold while keeping the foot relaxed.

intervals.coachNote: Use combinations with both feet planted; do not bounce or pivot forcefully.
regressions: Slow the combinations or reduce the range while keeping the feet planted.

intervals.coachNote: Walk briskly backward with whole-foot landings and a clear path.
regressions: Use a wall or rail for support and slow the pace.

intervals.coachNote: Hinge actively from the hips; this is not a passive stretch.
regressions: Bring the legs closer or reduce the hinge range while keeping the spine long.

intervals.coachNote: Alternate sides with a three-second extension and return; keep the pelvis controlled.
regressions: Bend the knee more or reduce the range if the back or hamstring pulls.

intervals.coachNote: Use a gentle stretch with a posterior pelvic tilt; do not force the front of the hip.
regressions: Shorten the stance or raise the torso if the stretch becomes painful.

intervals.coachNote: Use a gentle stretch with a posterior pelvic tilt; do not force the front of the hip.
regressions: Shorten the stance or raise the torso if the stretch becomes painful.

intervals.coachNote: Hold each side symmetrically for 20 seconds with calm breathing.
regressions: Use a smaller side bend and keep both feet planted.

intervals.coachNote: Finish with calm breathing and keep the final 20-second rest.
